summary: Umpqua NF tree lookout in Douglas County, OR, established 1930 at 18 ft; no longer in use, but the original platform is still visible in the tree on a Forest Service trail.

facts.status_note: No longer in use as a lookout; the original platform, grown into the tree, can still be seen.

access.note: Forest Service recreation trail #1526, reached from Hemlock Lake Campground via the Yellow Jacket Loop Trail #1522

visit.trail_note: Park near the Hemlock Lake picnic area and hike the Yellow Jacket Loop Trail #1522; Flat Rock Trail #1526 begins at milepost 1.25 on that loop. The approach ends with 12 miles of gravel road.

events.note: Established in a tree with the platform at the 18-foot level, per the Oregon lookouts history

Platform described as still there in the 1980s; listed as abandoned

notes_for_editor: The record's status 'gone' conflicts with the Forest Service page, which says the original platform, grown into the tree, can still be seen; firelookout.org's list also shows it as 'Platform Abandoned'. The elevation 5310' appears only in a search snippet from firelookout.com, not in the fetched page, so it is not used. No staffing source found. The Forest Service page is undated, so its condition statement may lag. The trail is public; the tree is retired, and no source encourages climbing it.
